name: demo_session
description: Authored pre-market scenario for DEMO runs against real free-tier reference data. Values are RELATIVE (gap_pct / premarket_volume_ratio) so the scenario stays meaningful after a nightly reference refresh: 'gaps up 7%' remains a 7% gap tomorrow, while a hardcoded price would silently drift out of the band. Every ticker here exercises a different branch of the funnel - see 'expectation' on each entry. NOT market data: these are constructed inputs standing in for the live pre-market feed V1 cannot access.
